notes: *And when* read as one coordinator-plus-subordinator rendering of the single waw, headed on the coordinator; the corpus also heads such units on *when* (rule 55).
The article on הָאֲנָשִׁים takes the demonstrative *these* the ASV writes in its place, so the construct פִי takes a supplied *the* (rules 29, 41).
The apodosis waw s012 is unrepresented, the ASV opening that clause bare (rule 14).
